apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: renewableops-ai
  name: renewableops-daily
  namespace: renewableops-app
spec:
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 2
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app.kubernetes.io/name: renewableops-daily
        spec:
          automountServiceAccountToken: false
          containers:
          - args:
            - renewableops
            - run-demo
            - --days
            - "90"
            envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: renewableops-config
            image: renewableops-api:1.0.0
            name: pipeline
            resources:
              limits:
                cpu: "2"
                memory: 2Gi
              requests:
                cpu: 250m
                memory: 512Mi
            securityContext:
              allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
              capabilities:
                drop:
                - ALL
          restartPolicy: Never
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400
  schedule: 17 5 * * *
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 2
  timeZone: Europe/Madrid
---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: renewableops-ai
  name: renewableops-api
  namespace: renewableops-app
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: renewableops-api
---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: renewableops-ai
  name: renewableops-api
  namespace: renewableops-app
spec:
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
  maxReplicas: 6
  metrics:
  - resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        averageUtilization: 70
        type: Utilization
    type: Resource
  minReplicas: 2
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: renewableops-api
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: 5m
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: renewableops-ai
  name: renewableops
  namespace: renewableops-app
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
  - host: renewableops.local
    http:
      paths:
      - backend:
          service:
            name: renewableops-api
            port:
              name: http
        path: /api
        pathType: Prefix
      - backend:
          service:
            name: renewableops-dashboard
            port:
              name: http
        path: /
        pathType: Prefix
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - renewableops.local
    secretName: renewableops-tls

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: renewableops-ai
  name: dashboard-to-api
  namespace: renewableops-app

  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: renewableops-dashboard

    - port: 8000
      protocol: TCP
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: renewableops-api
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
